title: Expense into a treasury with zero balance (insufficient balance)
exproExpectation: E36: a negative treasury balance is accepted; Dr category account (or 541) 50, Cr treasury account 50.
classificationNote: Accepted without warning in both; Daftra auto-creates an account named after the category (see D2-S04) whereas Expro routes to the category account or 541.

title: Expense with 15% VAT, category, automatic sub-account (two input paths)

pathA.tax: القيمة المضافة (page adds it: amount becomes 230, tax 30)

reports.expenseView: المبلغ 230.00 / القيمة المضافة 30.00 and المبلغ 200.00 / القيمة المضافة 26.09

exproExpectation: T-25: Dr expense 200, Dr 215002 30, Cr treasury 230; Expro amount = amount paid including tax with tax_amount a part of it.
classificationNote: The server treats the posted amount as the TOTAL including tax and books net = amount - tax. T-25 case amount-entered-includes-the-tax should therefore be re-classified from differs to matches at the stored-amount level; the only difference is the page script that adds tax to a typed amount.

title: Expense with a chosen sub-account (545 إيجار) instead of automatic
exproExpectation: No per-expense account: account is the category account when set, else 541.
classificationNote: Daftra lets each expense pick any account (the chosen account overrides the category account); Expro has only the category account.

title: Expense category: no account field, automatic account per category, mandatory-account settings visible

reports.accountsCreated: 546 افتراضي-D2 تصنيف مصروف (id 391), 4204 افتراضي-D2 تصنيف إيراد (id 392), created on first use; they survive deletion of the category and are deleted separately from /owner/journal_accounts/delete/<id>
reports.settings: expenses_mandatory and income_mandatory exist as visible options, both unchecked, not toggled

exproExpectation: FIN-04: optional account_id on the category, fallback to routed 541; accounting_expense_account_required setting (off).
classificationNote: Daftra has no account field on the category; it creates an account named after the category on first use. Expro asks the user to pick an account for the category. The mandatory-account settings exist in Daftra (not toggled here: needs batch C).

title: Edit of a posted expense: amount, tax, date, treasury

reports.journalLog: same journal 141 edited in place: each step logs «تعديل» on every line; no reversing journal; the no-change save left the journal untouched
reports.treasuryT1: moved out of T1 and back

messages: tax typed 45 was not kept: stays 39.13 (15% extracted from the amount)

exproExpectation: E15: reverse and re-post: a new journal revision for every change that touches the entry; no in-place edit.
classificationNote: Same ledger effect, different mechanism: Daftra keeps journal number 141 and edits the lines in place (history only in the journal log); Expro reverses and re-posts with a new revision. Also the tax amount cannot be edited independently in Daftra.

title: Delete of an expense

reports.journal142: disappears (journal log shows «حذف» on every line); no reversing journal

messages: confirmation page «هل أنت متأكد من حذف المصروفات التالي ؟ 5» then نعم

exproExpectation: Delete reverses the journal (a reversing entry stays in the books).
classificationNote: Daftra erases the journal entirely; Expro keeps both the original and its reversal.

title: Draft expense and the «issue» / «convert to draft» actions

messages: تم إصدار المصروف #Draft-7 رقم المسودة بالرقم التالي …

exproExpectation: No draft state for expenses (only a deleted flag).
classificationNote: Expro has no draft expense; Daftra gives draft numbers «Draft-N», assigns the real number at issue and creates the journal then.

title: Expense and revenue voucher without category and without sub-account
exproExpectation: A category without an account falls back to routed 541.
classificationNote: Expense: matches (541). Revenue has no Expro counterpart (FIN-03).

title: Multi-account expense (two accounts, one line with VAT)
exproExpectation: Single-account expenses only.
classificationNote: Multi-account expenses do not exist in Expro (FIN-02/WP3).

reports.incomesReportColumns: الكود، التاريخ، خزينة، التصنيف، البائع، الحساب الفرعي، مدخل العملية، ملاحظة، المبلغ (SAR)
reports.profitLoss: income category account 1,130.43 under إيرادات أخرى
reports.treasurySystemTransactions: issued journals only with running balance

classificationNote: Reference behaviour for the future implementation: Dr treasury total, Cr income account (category account auto-created on first use or chosen account) net, Cr 215001 tax; edit in place; delete removes the journal.

title: Supplier opening balance: journal, statement, aging, edit, delete

reports.deleteResult: journal 135 removed, supplier balance 0, button أضافة رصيد الافتتاحي returns

exproExpectation: E35/E37: opening balance «ما علينا» as a purchase without items: Dr 214, Cr supplier.
classificationNote: Journal lines match (Dr 214 / Cr supplier). Differences: Daftra stores it as a negative payment record #000028 with its own date, it feeds «الرصيد قبل» and the aging by that date, it is edited in place and deleted with its journal.

title: Supplier standalone payment 700 over an opening balance 500, then a new purchase, then delete the payment

documents.afterSave: مدفوعة جزئياً paid 200 remaining 100 via automatic payment #000030 (وسيلة رصيد المورد)

reports.afterDeletingPayment: journal 155 deleted, automatic payment #000030 withdrawn, P4 unpaid 300, balance 800, T1 back

exproExpectation: E35/E37: Dr supplier, Cr treasury; the credit is spent at once on the oldest open purchase (E34: immediate); deleting the payment un-spends it (E30).
classificationNote: Journal and delete behaviour match (E30). Timing differs (G-60): Daftra applies the credit when the new purchase is saved; Expro applies it immediately.

title: Edit of a saved purchase line: quantity then price (average cost and journal)
exproExpectation: G-37/E15: saved receiving lines are not edited; corrections are by return or delete.
classificationNote: Daftra edits the journal in place (same number 159) and recomputes the stock movement and the product average; Expro refuses line edits.

title: Delete and restore a purchase invoice: effect on the average cost

reports.trash: خلال 90 أيام «الحذف النهائي»; Delete Permanently asks for confirmation

exproExpectation: G-43: deleting a receiving does not change the average cost (the item cost is not recomputed).
classificationNote: Daftra recomputes the average from the remaining movements (back to 100.00 after deleting the 8x140 purchase); Expro leaves the item cost as it was.

title: Partial purchase refund (3 of 10) at a higher current average, without and with cash refund

inputs.R1: 3 units at invoice price 100, no cash refund
inputs.R2: 2 units at 100 with refund to T1

exproExpectation: ReceivingPostingBuilder::giveBack: Dr supplier total, Cr tax input, Cr inventory at the current unit cost, difference to 511; cash refund as a second journal; average unchanged (T-15).
classificationNote: Identical lines and amounts (53.33 and 35.56 to 511).

title: Purchase debit note with stock and a unit price above the average
exproExpectation: A return without cash refund (credit left with the supplier) uses the same builder: stock at average, difference to 511 (credit when the price exceeds the average).
classificationNote: Same accounts and amounts as a refund; Daftra splits the document into two kinds (refund with its own cash-refund journal, debit note) whereas Expro has one return document.

reports.status: مدفوع بالزيادة with banner, then مدفوعة

reports.option1: payment reduced in place to 100, 50 returns to T1

messages: إجمالي الفاتورة هو:100.00 , وقد أضفت إجمالي:150.00 مدفوعات لهذه الفاتورة ,50.00 الإضافية عبارة عن دفعة زائدة …
You must select an option (client alert when no option)

exproExpectation: E29: a payment above the purchase leaves the surplus as supplier credit; no settle button; a user would edit or delete the payment.
classificationNote: Option 2 reaches the same economic state as Expro (surplus kept as credit) but by splitting the payment; option 1 (remove the excess and return cash) has no Expro counterpart. Both options are reversible only by editing or deleting payments.

title: Treasury deletion and deactivation rules; transfers

inputs.B: bank account with two transfers and balance 0
inputs.T1: cash treasury with transfers only and balance 0

reports.deleteB: refused: «يحتوي هذا البنك على معاملات حالية أو تم تعيينها للموظفين أو تم تعيينها لدفتر الشيكات أو لديها سلفة، يمكنك جعله غير نشط»
reports.deleteT1: refused with the same text for «هذه الخزانة»
reports.deactivate: allowed at zero balance; the transfer button disappears; تنشيط restores

exproExpectation: P6: a treasury without movement can be deleted, one with movement cannot; deactivation refused when the balance is not zero (D3-a, stricter than Daftra); a transfer is cancelled by a reversing entry.
classificationNote: Delete rule matches (movement, not balance, blocks deletion). Differences: Daftra cannot delete or cancel a transfer (only edit it in place), Expro cancels by reversal; Daftra allows deactivating a treasury with a balance (observed in S35).

reports.hardDelete: expenses, incomes, payments, permits, stocktake, suppliers
